name: Compliance Pack
tagline: Logging an auditor can sit with.
summary: HIPAA-guardrailed logging, ASC 842 / regulated-filing alignment, and audit exports formatted for external review. Credible because the healthcare and compliance verticals already exist — not because the SKU is speculative.
description: Compliance Pack is the regulated overlay on the audit trail. Healthcare gets HIPAA-guardrailed logging. Finance gets ASC 842 and regulated-filing alignment. Both get exports a third-party reviewer can open without a SINCOR login. The setup fee covers guardrail configuration, retention, and the first export path. This is not a generic 'we take security seriously' add-on. It sits on verticals that already run.
buyer: Healthcare RCM, clinic ops, or a finance team whose agents touch PHI, filings, or lease/contract data that an external reviewer will ask about.

features.name: HIPAA-guardrailed logging
features.detail: Minimum necessary, access attribution, and retention suited to PHI-adjacent agent work.

features.name: ASC 842 / regulated-filing alignment
features.detail: Trail and export shape that maps to lease and regulated-filing review, not a generic CSV.

features.name: External-review exports
features.detail: Packages a reviewer can take. Chain, signatures, access log, retention statement.

features.name: Setup & guardrail configuration
features.detail: The $2,500 setup is real work: scopes, retention, export path, named reviewers.

includes: OBS-02 capabilities under the compliance overlay

source_components.maps_to: Signed trail, forensic context, HIPAA/SOX/PCI-DSS/GDPR tags already on the logger.
Existing healthcare vertical — this SKU is packaging, not invention.

readiness.next_action: Lead with healthcare RCM and finance filing buyers. Do not sell this as a hypothetical GRC product.
